company.name: InnoVein
company.shortDescription: InnoVein develops a medical device designed to offer implants for valve replacement in the femoral vein.
company.description:
InnoVein is a venture-backed medical device company focusing on cardiac and arterial approaches. The company develops and offers an implantable valve that can regularize blood flow in the veins of the elderly suffering from venous insufficiency disease. 

InnoVein was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in San Carlos, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: InnoVein is engaged in research and development of a prosthetic venous valve, as described in 'Venous valve with enhanced flow properties.' This device features an expanding anchoring frame, a valve seat positioned centrally, and a ball within the frame lumen, secured by at least one retention tether. The design aims to address valve replacement in the femoral vein, focusing on structural components that support enhanced flow properties and secure implantation.
